records.current_service_basis: Rigas identified his current State Department role in his October 1 Senate testimony. The September 14 State schedule independently names him. The November 4 Federal Register reproduces a June 29 signature.
records.role_source_note: The State Department biography returned 403. The official hearing page links the testimony. A timestamped hearing transcript corroborates the October 1 title. The Federal Register signature dates to June 29.
